column1: # core-writes-allow.tsv (harbor#1275) - core scripts that may write into the checkout because the write is not a stray file.
# Columns, tab-separated, one header row:  path  target  reason
#   path    a tracked file, or a directory prefix ending in "/"
#   target  the path under the tree the script writes, or * for every target of that script
#   reason  required: why the write cannot leave an untracked file in a harbor-core clone
# Read by bin/lint-core-writes.sh; a row without a reason refuses the run. A tracked core file, a gitignored path and a mkdir of a
# tracked directory are never counted, so they need no row: a row is for what the rules cannot see (a file the script creates
# and the repo does not track, written because the operator ran the command that says so).

column3: writes only when its dev-layer source harbor-build-tickets.md exists; in a core clone it refuses before any write (harbor#1275)
